meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.23;
father of: Seraiah (H8304I)
§ Tanhumeth = "consolation"
father of Seraiah, a leader who joined Gedaliah after Jerusalem's fall
